text:
Residents' Routines:
Felix (40s): Weekdays, home in the morning; out at work 13:40–23:00. Weekends, off work; errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: movies, houseplants.
Aisha (50s): Works from home. Weekdays, at desk 09:00–17:30; sometimes out for lunch. Weekends, sleeps in; errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: friends, meditation, movies.
Ines (30s): Works from home. Weekdays, at desk 09:00–17:30; sometimes out for lunch. Weekends, sleeps in; errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: baking, reading, running.

Object Locations & Movement:
Balcony: Watering can (floor), gardening gloves (table).
Bathroom: Felix’s hair dryer, shared laundry basket, Aisha’s razor/skincare, Ines’ skincare (shelf). Aisha/Felix meds (cabinet). Shared soap/toothbrushes (sink). Felix’s razor (sink). Individual towels (rack).
Bedroom 1 (Felix): Pen, plant pot 3 (desk). Book, glasses, tablet (nightstand).
Bedroom 2 (Aisha): Meditation cushion (floor). Headphones, laptop, mug, pen (desk). Book, phone (nightstand).
Bedroom 3 (Ines): Headphones, laptop, mug, pen (desk). Book, glass, phone (nightstand).
Entry: Doormat, Aisha umbrellas (floor). Aisha/Ines jackets, Aisha/Ines scarves (hook). Aisha/Ines keys, Ines sunglasses, Aisha/Ines wallets (table). Ines running shoes, Aisha/Ines shoes (rack).
Kitchen: Cutting board, kettle, knife block, plant pot 2 (counter). Pan, pot, snack bowl (cupboard). Aisha plate (dish rack). Knife, spatula (drawer). Fruit bowl, Felix plate, Ines plate, Ines water bottle (table). Baking tray, mixing bowl, recipe book, shopping bag (pantry). Aisha/Felix/Ines bowls, glasses, Felix mug, Ines plate (sink).
Living: Board game, speaker, vase (bookshelf). Candle, coasters, Aisha/Felix/Ines magazines, tissue box (coffee table). Blanket (couch). Lamp, plant pot 1 (side table). Remote (TV stand).
Storage: Ironing board, vacuum (floor). Toolbox (shelf).

Notes:
- Felix leaves the house around 16:00 on weekdays, taking his backpack, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet, and water bottle. These items are typically found in the entryway or Bedroom 1 in the morning and are absent during evening patrols.
- Aisha and Ines are home during evening patrols on weekdays, working from their respective desks in Bedroom 2 and Bedroom 3.
- Aisha and Ines often move their phones from nightstands to "not in any room" (likely carried on person) around 08:00, and they are not seen in the evening.
- Ines moves her headphones, mug, and water bottle to her desk around 09:24 for work, and back to other spots (sink, table) by 16:00.
- Aisha moves her laptop, mug, and pen to her desk around 16:00 for work, and back to nightstand/cupboard/floor by 00:00.
- Dishes (bowls, mugs, plates, glasses) are often moved from sink/dish rack to cupboard overnight (00:00) and back to sink/table by 08:00-16:00.
- On weekends, all residents are home except during midday errands.
- Ines appears to bake in the evening (19:53), moving the recipe book, pan, pot, knife, and spatula to the counter.
